Title: Play animation
Description: Play an animation on the NPC.

Inputs.Description: Connect to the Body pin of a Node, Option, Branch or Alternative. Statements run in the order of their links.

Options.Label: Animation
Options.Description: Animation name on the NPC's model, e.g. Wave.

Options.Label: Slot
Options.Description: Emote by default; Status is what the game uses for greetings.
